title: server: directory advertises endpoints mimid does not serve
description: crates/mimid-server/src/directory.rs Directory::new publishes all ten protocol-06 §5.1 URLs, but http.rs routes only six (update, submitMessage, groupInfo, reportAbuse, keyMaterial, notify); requestConsent, updateConsent, identifierQuery and proxyDownload answer 404 (documented in http.rs:32-33 Limitations). A peer that follows the directory gets 404 instead of learning the endpoint is not offered. Decision mimid-1wgh.5.75 (absent key = not offered) now allows omitting them. Fix: publish only routed endpoints (make the server Directory reuse mimi_protocol::Directory with Option fields, cf. mimid-1wgh.5.40), and add each back when its route lands. Regression test first: the served directory has no key whose route 404s. Found during Haven interop (mimid-1wgh.46).
close_reason: Server directory now lists only the six routed endpoints (keyMaterial, update, notify, submitMessage, groupInfo, reportAbuse); consent, identifierQuery, proxyDownload return with their routes (.7.32, .7.33, .8). Regression test tests/directory_routes.rs (fallback 418 oracle) failed before (identifierQuery unrouted). Unit test narrowed to the routed set per decision .5.75. Six gates pass (88 suites).
